Item (g), page 953, subparagraph 41, for the Province of Sorsogon, paragraph a, Title G, section
three of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred is amended to read as follows:
"(g) Tuba-Malapoc Communal Irrigation Project, Donsol ?25,000.00"
